bio.text: Veronica Escobar, a third-generation El Pasoan, represents Texas's 16th Congressional District and serves on the House Appropriations Committee.
Before Congress she served on the El Paso County governing body, first as a County Commissioner and then as County Judge.
She was earlier an English teacher at the University of Texas at El Paso and El Paso Community College, and is a graduate of UTEP and New York University.
